key_insight: VQE usually fails to reach the true ground state for these Heisenberg spin-glass Hamiltonians, but it can still produce states with enough overlap to be useful as QPE initial states.
engineering_relevance: For quantum simulation workflows, VQE may serve as a practical heuristic preprocessor for QPE when exact ground-state preparation is too costly, especially for disordered spin systems.
method: Classical numerical study of VQE on fully-connected anisotropic Heisenberg spin-glass Hamiltonians.
Tested system sizes up to 15 qubits and varied VQE ansatz depth.
Evaluated both ground-state overlap and achieved energy to judge usefulness for QPE initialization.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that deeper ansätze beyond three layers did not improve overlap or energy, and the best overlap did not show strongly exponential decay with system size.
watch_item: Low energy from VQE does not guarantee high ground-state overlap, so energy-only validation can be misleading for QPE state preparation.
paper_title: VQE as Initial State Preparation for QPE on Heisenberg Spin-Glass Hamiltonians
